messages:
akiko_partnerships: Quick kickoff — CrossCloud agreed to co-run a 45m webinar + live studio demo on May 12. Need to lock speakers, demo routing, and where swag will ship.
chris_hw: Happy to demo the edge appliance and quantized model perf. Is the demo running from our infra or theirs?
maria_pm: @chris_hw partner asked for us to run the model at their studio (low-latency switch) but have fallback to our hosted endpoint.
devin_eng: Prefer fallback to Dedicated pool with canary routing. I can provision a warm pool and a proxy; will need a simple healthcheck URL.
mar ia_pm: (typo) sorry — meant @devin_eng.
akiko_partnerships: @devin_eng makes sense. Can we get the healthcheck by Friday so studio ops can validate?
devin_eng: Yup — PUT /health returns 200 with body {"status":"ok"} — sample below:
```
curl -f https://demo.redwood-inference.com/api/health || exit 1
```
Will add header X-Demo-Run: crosscloud for routing.
rina_ops: For on-site kit shipping: partner prefers delivering to their studio, but we'll still send a backup kit to Redwood SF office. Need customs doc if anything goes to EU.
alex_sales: Swag plan: run two tiers — attendee stickers + 100 partner co-branded tees. Who owns fulfillment ops?
akiko_partnerships: Redwood will handle tees; CrossCloud handles local pickup and distribution at studio. @alex_sales please confirm branding files by next Tue.
chris_hw: Demo run-of-show suggestion (super short):
1) 5m intros (both speakers)
2) 10m product overview
3) 15m live demo (studio -> fallback)
4) 10m customer Q&A
5) 5m CTA & swag raffle
Keep the live demo scripted to three queries and a cold-start failover exercise.
maria_pm: Speaker list: Maria (host), Dmitri (CrossCloud lead), Chris (Redwood hw demo), Lina (customer cameo). Can Dmitri confirm?
akiko_partnerships: @maria_pm I'll loop in Dmitri and ask for a 5-line intro + a 10-slide deck. Deck deadline: May 3.
de vin_eng: Small note — demo will need genotype token for CrossCloud studio NAT. I'll add instructions and a one-liner to connect via our proxy:
```
ssh -i demo_key ubuntu@proxy.redwood-inference.com -L 8080:localhost:8080
```
Make sure studio ops has the key.
rina_ops: Shipping dates: tees out Apr 28 (US) and May 4 (EU). Partner customs contact: "Helena" at CrossCloud — akiko, can you share postal contact?
akiko_partnerships: Shared via DM. Also adding calendar-bot to lock the rehearsal time.
calendar-bot: Rehearsal created — May 8 09:00 PDT, duration 90m. Invitees: akiko_partnerships, chris_hw, maria_pm, devin_eng, dmitri_crosscloud, lina_customer.
alex_sales: Confirmed tees approved. Uploading final art to /assets/swag/crosscloud-tees-v4.png by EOD tomorrow.
chris_hw: Quick fallback test we'll run during rehearsal: block studio -> verify automatic route to Dedicated with < 200ms added latency. Devin can you add metric alarms?
devin_eng: I'll add an alert to Slack channel #eng-oncall if p95 increases > 150ms during rehearsal.
maria_pm: Speaker logistics — mics and webcam covered by studio. Chris, can you bring the USB capture dongle as backup?
chris_hw: Yes.
akiko_partnerships: Final asks: 1) Confirm speaker slides by May 3, 2) Healthcheck + SSH instructions (devin) by Apr 30, 3) Swag art (alex) by Apr 25, 4) Rehearsal attendance confirmed. Anything else?
alex_sales: Do we want a post-webinar CTA landing page? I can own it. Need copy + form fields.
maria_pm: Yes — simple demo signup + request trial credits. I'll draft copy and post in #product for feedback.
akiko_partnerships: Great — I'll follow up with CrossCloud on the partner promo code and PR timeline. Thanks everyone :tada:
